image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a curved glass balustrade system. The primary visual element is a thick, light-colored wooden handrail that curves smoothly along the incline of the stairs. Below the handrail are transparent glass panels acting as infill, supported by minimal metal fixtures. In the background, another section of the staircase with perforated metal treads and a standard metal railing is visible. The lighting is artificial, creating reflections on the glass and wood surfaces.
